note:
身份: 发光蘑菇洞穴的钓鱼商人。
关系: 把玩家当新结识的钓友。
说话方式: 随意、爱插话，常说听我说。
性格与词汇: 热衷碎鱼饵和自家补剂；chum 在材料与朋友之间双关。
禁用风格: 不把每个 ok 机械译成好吗，不混淆碎鱼饵和鱼饵。

island_messages.context: Abiphone 联系方式支线；复用同句而非重复翻译

island_messages.text: So listen.
island_messages.zh: 哎,听我说。

island_messages.text: The other day I was chumming with my chums.
island_messages.zh: 前几天,我跟几个钓友一块儿弄碎鱼饵。

island_messages.text: One of them yaps and I say, "ever tried my tonic"?
island_messages.zh: 有个家伙聊个没完,我就问他: 试过我做的补剂没?

island_messages.text: So yeah, I come back to my crib, right?
island_messages.zh: 后来啊,我就回自个儿的窝了。

island_messages.text: And listen, I've never seen anybody down here, but you seem like a nice fellow.
island_messages.zh: 说起来,还真没见过别人到这底下来。不过你看着挺好相处的。

island_messages.text: So just bring me Glowing Mushroom x8 and I'll show you how to chum, alright buddy?

segments.text: and I'll show you how to chum, alright buddy?
segments.zh: 来,我就教你怎么弄碎鱼饵,怎么样?

island_messages.zh: 这样吧,带点发光蘑菇 x8 来,我就教你怎么弄碎鱼饵,怎么样?
island_messages.gloss: 近期 Wiki 仍写 8 Glowing Mushrooms，实测为材料名 x8；两种写法均保留。

island_messages.text: So just bring me 8 Glowing Mushrooms and I'll show you how to chum, alright buddy?

segments.text: and I'll show you how to chum, alright buddy?
segments.zh: 来,我就教你怎么弄碎鱼饵,怎么样?

island_messages.zh: 这样吧,带 8 个发光蘑菇来,我就教你怎么弄碎鱼饵,怎么样?

island_messages.text: Ok listen now, I practice a secret chumming technique.
island_messages.zh: 好,听仔细了,我这可是弄碎鱼饵的独门秘技。

island_messages.text: It's reverse-chumming!
island_messages.zh: 那就是——反向打窝!

island_messages.text: Instead of chumming, it's the sea creatures giving you Chums.

segments.text: Instead of chumming, it's the sea creatures giving you
segments.zh: 不用你投饵,反过来让海洋生物给你

island_messages.zh: 不用你投饵,反过来让海洋生物给你碎鱼饵。

island_messages.text: Listen, it's very easy.
island_messages.zh: 听我说,简单得很。

island_messages.text: First we trade a Chum Bucket, ok?
island_messages.zh: 先在我这儿换个碎鱼饵桶。

island_messages.text: Just click me!
island_messages.zh: 点我就行!

island_messages.text: First you place down the bucket near water, right?
island_messages.zh: 先把桶放在水边。

island_messages.text: Then use a fishing rod and throw a line in said water.
island_messages.zh: 再拿出鱼竿,往那片水里甩一竿。

island_messages.text: Ok and you wait now. That part is easier with YOUR chums.
island_messages.zh: 接下来就等着。叫上你自己的钓友,这一步就轻松多了。

island_messages.text: Listen, time is shorter with friends.
island_messages.zh: 有朋友陪着嘛,时间过得快。

island_messages.text: After waiting you kill a sea creature and get a Chum.

segments.text: After waiting you kill a sea creature and get a
segments.zh: 等海洋生物上钩,干掉它,你就能拿到

island_messages.zh: 等海洋生物上钩,干掉它,你就能拿到碎鱼饵了。

island_messages.text: You put it in the bucket and someday it's filled.
island_messages.zh: 把碎鱼饵往桶里装,迟早能装满。

island_messages.text: Then listen you bring me the filled bucket, ok?
island_messages.zh: 记住啊,装满了就把桶带来给我。

island_messages.text: Wow ok listen that's good.
island_messages.zh: 哇,不错不错!

island_messages.text: You are the chumming expert ok?
island_messages.zh: 你这已经是弄碎鱼饵的行家了嘛!

island_messages.text: Listen. I also have some good items for your chumming.
island_messages.zh: 对了,我这儿还有不少好东西,能帮你弄碎鱼饵。

island_messages.text: And I have this really good tonic. It's a really good tonic, ok?
island_messages.zh: 还有我这补剂,真是好东西。我可没瞎吹啊。

island_messages.text: So get mushrooms, fill chum buckets, trade tonics! Easy chums!
island_messages.zh: 采蘑菇,装满碎鱼饵桶,来换补剂! 就这么简单,钓友们!

island_messages.text: ✆ Hey chum. Long time no see.

segments.text: Hey chum. Long time no see.

island_messages.zh: ✆ 哟,钓友,好久不见。

island_messages.text: ✆ Ok, listen.
island_messages.zh: ✆ 好,听我说。

island_messages.text: ✆ I got all my chums in my phone, ok?

segments.text: I got all my chums in my phone, ok?
segments.zh: 我的钓友啊,全存在手机里了。

island_messages.zh: ✆ 我的钓友啊,全存在手机里了。

island_messages.text: ✆ And we're chums too, you and I.

segments.text: And we're chums too, you and I.

island_messages.zh: ✆ 咱俩也是钓友,对吧。

island_messages.text: ✆ But I only got so many contact slots, you know?

segments.text: But I only got so many contact slots, you know?
segments.zh: 可通讯录就那么点空位啊。

island_messages.zh: ✆ 可通讯录就那么点空位啊。

island_messages.text: ✆ And who am I to say which of my chums are the most important, you know?

segments.text: And who am I to say which of my chums are the most important, you know?
segments.zh: 你说,我哪能给朋友排个三六九等呢?

island_messages.zh: ✆ 你说,我哪能给朋友排个三六九等呢?

island_messages.text: ✆ What kind of chum would that make me?

segments.text: What kind of chum would that make me?

island_messages.zh: ✆ 那我还算什么朋友啊?

island_messages.text: ✆ So, if you want your digits in my phone, imma need you to get me something...

segments.text: So, if you want your digits in my phone, imma need you to get me something...
segments.zh: 所以啊,想把你的号码存进来,得帮我带点东西……

island_messages.zh: ✆ 所以啊,想把你的号码存进来,得帮我带点东西……

island_messages.text: ✆ What do you think it is?

segments.text: What do you think it is?

island_messages.zh: ✆ 你猜会是什么?

island_messages.text: ✆ Of course it's chum, chum!
island_messages.zh: ✆ 当然是碎鱼饵啦,钓友!

island_messages.text: ✆ Bring me Full Chum Bucket x64 and I'll add you to my Abiphone!

segments.text: and I'll add you to my

island_messages.zh: ✆ 带点满碎鱼饵桶 x64 来,我就把你加进我的 Abiphone!

island_messages.text: ✆ Mates rates!
island_messages.zh: ✆ 这可是友情价!

island_messages.text: ✆ Hey chum, that's not it.
island_messages.zh: ✆ 哎,钓友,不是这个。

island_messages.text: ✆ I asked for Full Chum Bucket x64.
island_messages.zh: ✆ 我要的是满碎鱼饵桶 x64。

island_messages.text: ✆ Not whatever this is.
island_messages.zh: ✆ 不是你手里这玩意儿。

island_messages.text: ✆ Wow ok, that's good.
island_messages.zh: ✆ 哇,这就对了。

island_messages.text: ✆ This is the stuff. The good stuff.

segments.text: This is the stuff. The good stuff.

island_messages.zh: ✆ 就是这个。好东西啊。

island_messages.text: ✆ Here's my contact!
island_messages.zh: ✆ 喏,这是我的联系方式!

island_messages.text: ✆ You ever need chumming supplies just give your chum Moby a call!

segments.text: You ever need chumming supplies just give your chum Moby a call!
segments.zh: 以后缺弄碎鱼饵的东西,就给你的钓友 Moby 打电话!

island_messages.zh: ✆ 以后缺弄碎鱼饵的东西,就给你的钓友 Moby 打电话!

island_messages.text: ✆ Hey chum!
island_messages.zh: ✆ 哟,钓友!

source_note: 社区 Wiki 可见 Dialogue 表及商店 tooltip 连同颜色核对；实测新增 8 个蘑菇任务的材料 x8 写法，和近期 Wiki 不同，保留两种。电话通用询问和添加联系人通知复用共享语料。

messages.context: 作为花园访客提出委托
messages.text: Listen. Glowing Mushrooms don't seem to be too good for my health. About time I tried something else. You got anything, chum?
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 听着。发光蘑菇好像不太利于健康。该试点别的了。你有吃的吗,伙计?

messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。

messages.text: You are no chum of mine.
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
